previous_statement: Similarly ||mu(U,S)-U bold-dot S||<=84*epsilon_r and ||U bold-dot S-U bold-dot U^dagger||<171*epsilon_r. Node 1.2 gives ||U bold-dot U^dagger-J||<=25*epsilon_r, so the right-inverse defect is at most (84+171+25)*epsilon_r=280*epsilon_r.
new_statement: Fix U in calU and set S=sigma(U). By nodes 1.4 and 1.5, ||mu(U,S)-U bold-dot S||<=84*epsilon_r and ||S-U^dagger||<=84*epsilon_r. Nodes 1.1 and 1.2 give epsilon_r<=1/64, ||U||<=2, and ||U bold-dot U^dagger-J||<=25*epsilon_r; hence ||U bold-dot S-U bold-dot U^dagger||<171*epsilon_r, and the triangle inequality gives ||mu(U,sigma(U))-J||<=280*epsilon_r.
